title: Free Domain Name registry record
description: One record per file. The path is derived from `domain`; see scripts/shard.mjs.

domain.description: Exact lowercase hostname, including any TLD. One record per name.

target_url.description: HTTP(S) origin that serves this name: scheme://ip-or-host[:port]. No credentials, path, query or fragment; the browser appends the requested path and query. See docs/target-url.md.

owner_github.description: GitHub handle accountable for this record.
